submitted.rationale: Index 0 (Bi0.97Sb0.03) had the highest measured EQE, 3.1e-4 %. That is about 3.5x index 5 (sillenite-region Bi12SbO20, 8.7e-5 %), and index 14 (Bi3SbO7 region) came out slightly negative. EQE rose toward the Bi-rich end. XRD at index 0 shows extra peaks (Q≈2.007, 2.32, 3.28) that don't appear in the Sb-rich film. These probably come from a Bi2O3-type phase, which may absorb 2.4 eV photons better.

rejected.reason: Not measured for merit; its XRD lacks the Bi-rich phase peaks, and EQE fell as Sb content rose
